note: The Philippines (Executive Order 408 as amended): nationals of the countries on the Department of Foreign Affairs' list enter without a visa for 30 days (extendable at the Bureau of Immigration), Brazilians and Israelis for 59 days; 14 days for Indians (since 8 June 2025), Taiwan's (to 30 June 2027) and China's (to 15 January 2027, tourism only, at two airports) passports and Hong Kong's and Macao's. The DFA's pages refuse this client, so the list is read from Wikipedia's copy of it. Everyone else needs a visa (the substitute-visa routes for Chinese and Indian holders of certain third-country visas aren't modelled).

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of the Philippines: Ordinary passports
sources.said: Citizens of the following countries and territories may enter the Philippines for stays up to the duration listed below. ... 59 days Brazil Israel 30 days ASEAN member states (except Timor-Leste) All European Union member states Andorra Angola Antigua and Barbuda Argentina Australia ... Zambia Zimbabwe 14 days China Hong Kong India Macau Portugal Taiwan 7 days United Kingdom T1 - Temporary policy until January 15, 2027. T2 - Temporary policy until June 30, 2027.
